summary: Chippewa National Forest lookout about a mile west of Jessie Lake, Itasca County; a 1959 survey describes a 120-foot steel tower. Listed as gone.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The 1936 date is only the year column of the A-Z list; the 1959 details are from survey notes. No removal date, staffing, fire history, or present-day site description was found. The Central Lakes page is titled 'Jesse Lake' but the NGS text and the A-Z list use 'Jessie', so the record's spelling was kept. Unused leads from search results, not read: a Facebook post about 'a fire lookout tower in the Chippewa National Forest' used until 1976 (identity unconfirmed); a 1970 USGS map label 'Jessie Lake Lookout Tower' on pastmaps.com; a NARA photo 'Jesse Lake Lookout' (nara.getarchive.net returned 403). Worth checking for a Chippewa National Forest history or a removal date.
